# Tidewater Kayak Hire -- booking site (revised after the owners' meeting)

## First version
- Customers book a kayak for a time slot (1, 2 or 4 hours) on a chosen day.
- Payment stays at the kiosk for the first season; the site only takes the booking.
- Staff see the day's bookings and mark kayaks as out and returned.
- Staff can close the day for bad weather, which cancels that day's bookings and tells the customers.

## Cancellation rule
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the slot.

## Later
- Online payment.
- Guided tours.
